# Pillar RSK05: Tail fatness (one-sided)
Definition: Monthly 95% CVaR divided by monthly volatility over 120 months. Scale-free. One-sided against VWRA: only fatter tails than VWRA's are penalised, with k = 0.5. Weight 0.30 of RSK.
Source: yfinance .L and proxy monthly returns (verified). Better when: lower (one-sided). Informs: portfolio_mix.
